sloka: रामस्य च मया साह्ये वर्तितव्यमरिन्दम ।रामो धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः ।। ५.५८.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: rāmasya ca mayā sāhye vartitavyamarindama ।rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ śreṣṭho mahendrasamavikramaḥ ।। 5.58.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I heard Mainaka, I told him about my intention to go up. That great self Mainaka allowed me.
